DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先は果樹の観察区です。実を採らず、通路から色や形をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ahead is the fruit-tree observation area. Please view the colors and shapes from the path without picking fruit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 枝先に青い部分が広い実があります。隣の黄色い実と、熟し方が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い部分の広い実と黄色い実で熟し方が違うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a fruit at the branch tip with a large green area. Is it ripening differently from the yellow one beside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the largely green fruit and the yellow fruit ripen differently. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色の変化が見られますね。ただ、収穫できるかどうかは品種などでも変わるので、ここでは色の違いを観察しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can see the color changing. But harvest readiness also depends on variety and other factors, so let's observe the color differences here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色だけで採ってよいとは判断しないのですね。木の裏に三つ落ちていますが、触らず写真に撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色だけで収穫可否を判断しないと確認し落果三つに触らず撮影してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I shouldn't judge whether to pick it by color alone. There are three fallen fruits behind the tree. May I photograph them without touching them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that color alone does not determine harvest readiness and ask to photograph three fallen fruits without touching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路から撮影できます。木の裏へは入らないでください。落ちた実は園の担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can photograph them from the path. Don't go behind the tree. The orchard staff will check the fallen fruit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路に残って撮ります。ただ、少し先に枝が落ちていて、足元が通りにくくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路から撮影すると述べ先に落ちた枝で通りにくいと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll stay on the path to take the photo. But a little farther ahead, a fallen branch is making it difficult to walk through.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Photograph from the path and report a fallen branch obstructing passage ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。枝は動かさず、いったん来た道を戻りましょう。別の観察台から見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for telling me. Leave the branch where it is and let's go back the way we came. You can view from another observation platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 枝はそのままにします。観察台まで戻れば、高いところの実も見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枝を動かさないと答え観察台から高い実も見えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave the branch alone. If we return to the platform, can we see the fruit high up too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the branch unmoved and ask whether the platform provides a view of higher fruit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 観察台にある双眼鏡で見られます。首に掛けるひもを使い、その場で止まってのぞいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can use the binoculars on the platform. Use the neck strap and stand still while looking through them.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩きながらは使わず、ひもを掛けて観察します。帰る前に双眼鏡を元の台へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩きながら双眼鏡を使わずひもを掛け帰る前に台へ返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use them while walking; I'll put the strap on to observe. Before leaving, I'll return the binoculars to their original stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use binoculars with the strap while stationary and return them to the stand before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、ご返却はこちらへ。私は通路の枝を担当者へ知らせてきます。どうぞ観察をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, return them here. I'll tell the staff about the branch on the path. Enjoy observing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 筆を握る前に、今日はどんな一文字を書きたいか聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before picking up the brush, tell me which single character you would like to write today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海の景色が印象に残ったので、「海」を書きたいです。画数が多くても、初めてで取り組めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めてでも画数の多い「海」に取り組めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sea scenery left an impression on me, so I'd like to write the character for sea. Can a beginner attempt it even with its many strokes?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a beginner can attempt the many-stroked character for sea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一画ずつ練習してからなら取り組めます。まず縦線を一本引いてみてください。筆はもう少し立てましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can after practicing one stroke at a time. First, try a single vertical line. Hold the brush a little more upright.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 筆を立てると手が震えてしまいます。紙を押さえるほうの手は、どこに置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 筆を立てると手が震えると説明し紙を押さえる手の位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My hand shakes when I hold the brush upright. Where should I put the hand that holds the paper down?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that holding the brush upright makes your hand shake and ask where to place the paper-holding hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 墨の付いていない左下を軽く押さえてください。今の線は途中で力が抜けています。次は最後までゆっくり下ろしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Lightly hold down the ink-free bottom-left corner. You lost pressure partway through that line. Next time, lower the brush slowly all the way to the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後まで同じ速さで引いてみます。この紙の空いている右側で、もう一本練習してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 線を最後までゆっくり引くと述べ紙の右側で追加練習してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try drawing it at the same slow pace to the end. May I practice one more line on the empty right side of this sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Draw slowly to the end and ask to practice another line on the right of the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ええ、そこを使いましょう。線が安定したら、この清書用の紙に移ります。名前は作品の左側に小さく添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, let's use that area. Once the line is steady, we'll move to this final-copy paper. Add your name in small writing on the left of the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 清書では「海」を真ん中に大きく書き、名前は左に小さく書きます。名前はカタカナでも構いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中央に海と左側に小さい名前を配置し名前をカタカナで書いてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the final copy I'll write sea large in the center and my name small on the left. May I write my name in katakana?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Place sea centrally and a small name on the left and ask whether the name may be in katakana. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 構いません。書き終えた紙は、墨が乾くまでこちらの棚に置きます。濡れた面を重ねないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Put the finished paper on this shelf until the ink dries. Don't stack wet surfaces together.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作品を棚で乾かしてから受け取ります。まだ湿っていたら、折らずに運べる台紙を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 棚で乾燥後に受け取ると伝え湿った場合に折らずに運ぶ台紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll collect the work after it dries on the shelf. If it is still damp, could I borrow a backing board to carry it without folding it?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect after shelf drying and request a board for carrying without folding if still damp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 持ち帰り用の台紙をご用意します。筆はこの受け皿へどうぞ。本日の練習はここまでです。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll prepare a take-home backing board. Please put the brush in this tray. That concludes today's practice. Well done.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手元の案内図で気になる場所はありますか。今日は雨も降りそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anywhere on your map that interests you? It looks like rain today too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宿に荷物を預けていて、九十分後には戻ります。その間に屋内を一か所だけ見学したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 九十分後に宿へ戻る必要があり屋内一か所を見学したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've left my bags at my accommodation and need to return in ninety minutes. I'd like to visit just one indoor place in that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the need to return to your accommodation in ninety minutes and request one indoor visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、小展示室は宿から往復二十分、工房は往復四十分です。どちらも見学時間は三十分ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This guide gives twenty minutes round trip from your accommodation to the small gallery and forty to the workshop. Viewing takes about thirty minutes at either.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 移動が短い小展示室を候補にします。入り口までに階段はありますか。重い荷物を持った友人と合流する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 移動の短い小展示室を選び荷物のある友人のため階段の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll consider the small gallery with less travel. Are there stairs before the entrance? I'm planning to meet a friend carrying heavy luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the shorter-travel gallery as a candidate and ask about stairs because your friend has luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の施設案内には、段差のない入り口が裏手とあります。ただ、裏手の入口が今日使えるかは、施設への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The facilities guide says the step-free entrance is at the back. But we need to check with the venue whether that rear entrance is usable today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その入り口が使えるか、こちらで電話をかけてもらえますか。使えなければ、今日は見学をやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏手入口の利用可否を電話で確認してもらい不可なら見学をやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you telephone from here to check that entrance? If it isn't usable, I'll skip the visit today.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a phone check of rear-entrance availability and explain that you will skip the visit if unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れました。今日は裏手から入れるそうです。今からなら見学できますが、荷物預かりは行っていないとのことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've confirmed that you can enter from the back today. You can visit now, but they don't offer luggage storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には荷物を宿へ置いてから合流してもらいます。私たちは傘を持って行きますが、展示室内にも持ち込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人に宿へ荷物を置いてもらうと述べ展示室への傘の持込みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my friend to leave their luggage at the accommodation before meeting me. We'll take umbrellas; can we bring them into the gallery too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have your friend leave luggage at the accommodation and ask whether umbrellas can enter the gallery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 傘は入口の傘立てに置く案内だそうです。戻り道の分も含め、今から一時間で宿へ戻る計画なら余裕を残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: They say umbrellas go in the stand by the entrance. Planning to return to the accommodation within an hour from now, including the journey back, will leave a buffer.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 傘は入口に置き、一時間以内に宿へ戻ります。友人が遅れたら、入場せず宿で待ち合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傘を入口に置き一時間以内に戻り友人が遅れたら宿で会うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll leave umbrellas at the entrance and return within an hour. If my friend is late, we won't enter and will meet at the accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave umbrellas at the entrance, return within an hour and meet at the accommodation instead if your friend is late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その計画を案内図に書き込みました。こちらをお持ちください。それでは、足元にお気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've written that plan on the map. Please take it. Watch your step and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待たせしました。焼き魚弁当と唐揚げ弁当で、お会計に進んでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for waiting. A grilled-fish meal and a fried-chicken meal; shall we proceed to payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、唐揚げではなく野菜弁当を頼みました。焼き魚一個と野菜一個に直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 唐揚げを野菜に訂正し焼き魚と野菜を各一個にしてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I ordered vegetables, not fried chicken. Please change it to one grilled-fish meal and one vegetable meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct fried chicken to vegetables and request one fish and one vegetable meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 失礼しました。野菜弁当に取り替えます。温めるのは二つともですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'm sorry. I'll replace it with the vegetable meal. Would you like both heated?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 温めるのは焼き魚のほうだけです。野菜弁当は友人に渡すので、そのままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 焼き魚だけ温め友人用の野菜弁当は温めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the grilled-fish one. The vegetable meal is for my friend, so please leave it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Heat only the fish meal and leave your friend's vegetable meal unheated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 焼き魚だけ温めます。箸と袋は二人分お付けしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll heat only the fish. Would you like chopsticks and bags for two?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箸は二膳ください。袋は持っていますが、温めた弁当と野菜弁当を別の袋に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箸二膳を頼み持参した別々の袋へ弁当を入れたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two pairs of chopsticks, please. I have bags, but I'd like the heated meal and the vegetable meal in separate ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request two pairs of chopsticks and separate packing in your own bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれお客様の袋にお入れします。焼き魚が七百円、野菜が六百円で、合計千三百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll put each in your bags. The fish is seven hundred yen and vegetables six hundred, totaling thirteen hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の分と分けて払いたいです。先に野菜弁当の六百円を、こちらの現金で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別会計を希望し野菜弁当六百円から現金で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to pay separately from my friend's portion. Can I pay the six hundred yen for the vegetable meal first with this cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request separate payments and pay cash for the six-hundred-yen vegetable meal first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、別会計にします。野菜弁当の六百円を受け取りました。残りは焼き魚弁当の七百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, separate payments. I've received six hundred yen for the vegetables. Seven hundred remains for the fish.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 焼き魚の七百円はこちらの千円からお願いします。レシートも弁当ごとに分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 焼き魚七百円を千円で支払い弁当ごとにレシートを分けてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please take the fish meal's seven hundred from this thousand-yen note. Please separate the receipts by meal too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay the fish meal's seven hundred yen with one thousand and request separate receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三百円のお返しと、別々のレシートです。温めた焼き魚は右の袋に入れました。ありがとうございました。またどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are three hundred yen change and separate receipts. The heated fish is in the right bag. Thank you, and come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒をお預かりする前に、発送についてご指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before taking your envelope, do you have any mailing requirements?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座の申込書です。「発送した日がわかる控えを保管」と書かれていますが、追跡番号だけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込書の発送日のわかる控えという指示に追跡番号だけで足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a course application. It says to keep a receipt showing the mailing date. Is a tracking number alone enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether tracking alone meets instructions to retain proof of the application mailing date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号は配送状況を調べるためのものです。提出先が求める証明と一致するかは、この文面だけでは判断できません。発送日が載る控えのある方法をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The number is for checking delivery status. We can't tell from this wording alone whether it matches the recipient's proof requirements. We can explain a method that provides a dated mailing receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受理される保証まではできないのですね。先に講座の担当者へ、必要な控えを電話で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口が受理を保証できないと確認し講座担当者へ必要な控えを電話で聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you can't guarantee it will be accepted. I'll first phone the course administrator to check what receipt they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that acceptance cannot be guaranteed and call the course staff about required proof first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ、確認してからお戻りください。封筒はまだお預かりしていませんので、お手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please return after checking. We haven't accepted the envelope yet, so keep it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認できました。窓口で出した日付の載る控えが必要とのことです。追跡もできる方法の料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口発送日が載る控えが必要と報告し追跡可能な方法の料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've checked. They need a receipt showing the date sent at the counter. Please tell me the price of a method that also allows tracking.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the need for a counter-mailing date receipt and ask the price of a trackable method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応する方法の料金は重さで確認します。封筒はこのまま封をして発送してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the price of the appropriate method by weight. May we seal and send the envelope as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ署名を一か所書き忘れています。横の記入台で署名して、封をしてから量ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 署名が一か所未記入と伝え記入台で署名して封をした後に計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've still forgotten one signature. I'll sign at the writing counter beside us, seal it and then have it weighed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain one missing signature and sign and seal before weighing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りいただきありがとうございます。こちらで量ると、選んだ方法の送料は合計五百円です。発送日と番号を記した控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for returning. Weighing it here, the chosen method totals five hundred yen. We'll give you a receipt with the mailing date and number.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五百円を払います。控えは提出先から照会が来る場合に備えて、申込書のコピーと一緒に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送料五百円を支払い照会に備えて控えと申込書コピーを一緒に保管すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay five hundred yen. I'll keep the receipt with a copy of the application in case the recipient makes an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay five hundred yen and retain the receipt with the application copy for possible inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらがお預かりした封筒の控えです。日付と番号をご確認ください。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-ISHIGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the receipt for the envelope we've accepted. Please check the date and number. Thank you, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の映像ショーまでは五十分ほどあります。水槽の見学でしたら、今から入れますよ。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-01.translation: The next video show is about fifty minutes away. You can enter the aquarium viewing area now.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四十分後には出たいので、ショーは見ずに水槽だけ回れますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残り四十分なのでショーではなく水槽だけの見学が可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to leave in forty minutes. Can I visit just the tanks without seeing the show?
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: With forty minutes available, ask about viewing tanks only rather than the show. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。奥の展示まで行かず、入口側の三つの水槽なら余裕があります。特に見たい生き物はありますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. If you stay with the three tanks near the entrance rather than going to the rear exhibits, you'll have enough time. Are there particular creatures you'd like to see?

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さな魚が群れで泳ぐ水槽を見たいです。暗い通路も通りますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 群泳する小魚を希望し暗い通路の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like the tank with small fish swimming in a school. Will I have to go through a dark passage?
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request schooling small fish and ask about dark passages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その水槽は明るい通路にあります。ただ、手前の展示では照明を落としています。そちらを避ける経路もあります。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-05.translation: That tank is on a bright passage, but the exhibit before it has dimmed lighting. There is a route avoiding it too.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 暗い所を避ける道を、この案内図に線で引いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗所を避ける経路を案内図に記入してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you draw a line on this map showing the route that avoids the dark areas?
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a marked route avoiding dark places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この線に沿って進むと、三つ目が群れの水槽です。そこはフラッシュなしで撮影できます。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow this line and the third tank is the schooling fish. You may take photographs there without flash.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 魚の写真を撮りたいので、先に携帯のフラッシュを切ります。水槽に手を近づけてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: フラッシュを切ると伝え水槽への手の近づけ方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like fish photos, so I'll turn off my phone's flash first. Is it all right to bring my hands close to the tank?
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Turn off flash and ask about bringing your hands near the tank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ガラスをたたいたり、手で魚を追ったりするのはお控えください。離れた位置からお願いします。出口は最後の水槽の横です。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't tap the glass or follow fish with your hands. Stay back from it. The exit is beside the last tank.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ガラスから離れて撮ります。三つ目の水槽を見たら、横の出口から出ます。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ガラスから離れて撮影し三つ目の水槽横の出口から出ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take photos away from the glass. After viewing the third tank, I'll leave through the exit beside it.
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Photograph away from the glass and exit beside the third tank afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その回り方で結構です。案内図をどうぞ。お気をつけてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-OKN-NAGO-001-SHARED-11.translation: That route is fine. Here is your map. Take care and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの列の実を取ります。この色見本と比べて、色が十分に変わったものだけにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll pick fruit from this row. Compare with this color sample and take only fruit whose color has changed sufficiently.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日陰側だけ緑色の実があります。見本と違う部分があれば、木に残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 色むらのある実を木に残すか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Some fruit is green only on the shaded side. If any part differs from the sample, should I leave it on the tree?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether unevenly colored fruit should remain on the tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。色むらのある実は残してください。次に、表面に傷のある実を見つけたら、どうするか説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, leave unevenly colored fruit. Next I'll explain what to do if you find fruit with surface damage.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この実には浅い傷があります。収穫して別の箱に分ける対象でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 浅い傷のある具体的な実の収穫と仕分けを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This fruit has a shallow scratch. Is it one to harvest and separate into another box?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about harvesting and sorting this particular shallow-scratched fruit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それは収穫して黄色い箱へ入れます。傷のない実は青い箱です。腐っているように見えるものは、触る前に呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Harvest that one and put it in the yellow box. Undamaged fruit goes in blue. If something looks rotten, call me before touching it.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黄色と青の箱を分けて置きます。はさみの刃が少し欠けているので、交換してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱を分けると伝え刃が欠けたはさみの交換を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep the yellow and blue boxes separate. The scissor blade is slightly chipped; could you replace them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the boxes and request replacement of chipped scissors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのはさみは使わず、こちらへ渡してください。交換用を持ってきました。開閉に引っかかりはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't use those scissors; give them here. I've brought replacements. Do they catch when opening and closing?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しいはさみは滑らかに動きます。ただ、枝の上の実には手が届きません。今日は残しておいていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換後の動作を報告し届かない実を残す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The new scissors move smoothly. But I can't reach the fruit above the branch. May I leave it today?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report smooth operation after replacement and ask permission to leave unreachable fruit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 高い実は別の担当が取るので、残してください。背伸びや脚立での作業はせず、地面に立って届く範囲だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Someone else will pick high fruit, so leave it. No stretching onto tiptoe or using a stepladder; only pick what you can reach while standing on the ground.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 高い実は残し、地面から届く実だけ取ります。腐りが疑われる実を見つけたら、その木の所で呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地上から届く実に限定し腐敗が疑われる時にその木で報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave high fruit and pick only what I can reach from the ground. If I find fruit that may be rotten, I'll call you at that tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limit picking to ground reach and report suspected rot at the relevant tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。交換した道具を持って、まず一緒に一本目を見ましょう。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Take the replacement tool and let's inspect the first tree together. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の前にお知らせです。本日は風が強いため、たき火と調理用の火は使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before registering, please note that strong winds mean no campfires or cooking fires today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕食を炭火で焼くつもりでした。小型のガスこんろも使用禁止に含まれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 炭火の予定を説明しガスこんろも禁止か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to grill dinner over charcoal. Does the ban include a small gas stove too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your charcoal cooking plan and ask whether gas stoves are banned too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今日はガスこんろも含みます。火を使わない食事で過ごすか、利用を見送るか、お決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, gas stoves are included today. Please decide whether to stay with food requiring no fire or forgo using the site.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 火を使わずに食べられる物を持っているので泊まります。二人用のテントを張れる区画は空いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 火を使わない食事で宿泊すると決め二人用区画の空きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have food I can eat without fire, so I'll stay. Is a pitch for a two-person tent available?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to stay with food requiring no fire and ask about a two-person tent pitch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一張り用の区画が空いています。テントを広げたときの縦と横の長さを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: A single-tent pitch is free. Please tell me the tent's length and width when opened out.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 縦も横も二メートルです。ロープを張る分も含めて収まるか、先に区画を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: テントの寸法を伝えロープも含めて設営可能か実地確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two meters in both directions. I'd like to see the pitch first to check that it fits including the guy ropes.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give tent dimensions and request an on-site check including guy-rope space. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見ていただけます。目印の線の内側で、隣の通路をふさがないか確かめてください。水場は共用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may view it. Check that it fits inside the marked lines without blocking the neighboring passage. Water facilities are shared.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 線の内側に収まりました。この区画にします。食器を洗った水は、水場の流しへ捨ててよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 区画を選び食器を洗った水の処理場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It fits within the lines. I'll choose this pitch. May I dispose of dishwashing water in the sink at the water area?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the pitch and ask where to dispose of dishwashing water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、食べ残しは先に取り除き、流しの表示に従ってください。夜に利用中止の案内が出た場合は、受付横の建物へ集まってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Remove food scraps first and follow the sink signs. If a notice suspending use is issued at night, gather at the building beside reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食べ残しを取り除いてから洗います。夜に中止の案内が出たら、受付横の建物へ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食べ残しの処理と利用中止時の集合先を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll remove food scraps before washing. If use is suspended at night, I'll move to the building beside reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat food-scrap handling and the gathering place if use is suspended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その区画で受け付けます。火は使わず、お困りの際は受付まで。お気をつけてお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll register that pitch. Don't use fire, and come to reception if you need help. Take care during your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 光の体験展示をご覧になりますか。かばんが台に当たりそうなので、先に脇の棚へ置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try the light exhibit? Your bag may hit the stand, so could you first put it on the side shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きいかばんだけ棚に置きます。貴重品の入った小さい袋は身につけていてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きいかばんを棚に置き貴重品の小袋を携帯できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll put only the large bag on the shelf. May I keep the small bag with my valuables on me?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Put the large bag away and ask to keep the small valuables bag with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい袋はそのままで結構です。こちらは、三色の光を同じ場所に当てる装置です。どの部分を試してみたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small bag is fine. This device directs three colors of light at the same spot. Which part would you like to try?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三色を重ねるとどう見えるか試したいです。手前のつまみを回すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三色を重ねる実験を選び操作するつまみを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see what happens when all three overlap. Do I turn the knob at the front?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the three-color overlap experiment and check which knob to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。右へ少しずつ回すと光が重なります。物の色を混ぜるのとは違って見える点にも注目してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Slowly turn it right to overlap the light. Notice how it differs from mixing colors of physical materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 光を重ねた部分が白く見えました。説明にある「光源」は、光を出す物という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白く見えた結果を伝え光源の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The overlapping area looked white. Does the explanation's word 'light source' mean something that emits light?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the white result and check the meaning of light source. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その意味です。この装置では三つのランプが光源ですね。分かりにくければ、説明カードもお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. The three lamps are the light sources here. If it is unclear, I can give you an explanation card too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あとで読み直したいので、説明カードを一枚ください。装置の写真も記録用に撮れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明カードを頼み記録写真の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to reread it later, so please give me one card. Can I also photograph the device for my records?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an explanation card and ask about a record photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この装置は撮影できます。ほかのお客様の顔が入らないようお願いします。使い終わったら、つまみを左端へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: This device may be photographed. Please avoid including other visitors' faces. After use, return the knob fully to the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人が写らない向きで撮ります。つまみを左端へ戻したので、かばんを取って次の展示へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人を写さず撮影しつまみを戻して荷物を取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll photograph in a direction without people. I've returned the knob fully left, so I'll collect my bag and go to the next exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Photograph without others, reset the knob and collect your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の位置に戻していただき、ありがとうございます。カードをどうぞ。引き続きご見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning it to its original position. Here is your card. Enjoy the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの洗剤は、袋入りが詰め替え用で、右のボトルが本体です。容器はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: For this detergent, the pouch is a refill and the bottle on the right is the main product. Do you have a container?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 容器はまだありません。袋にお得とありますが、ボトルと容量も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容器を持っていないと伝え安い詰め替え袋と本体の容量を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. The pouch says good value, but is its capacity the same as the bottle?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no container and compare the refill and bottle capacities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は八百ミリリットルで四百八十円、本体は五百ミリリットルで四百円です。値札にもそれぞれ容量を書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pouch is eight hundred milliliters for four hundred eighty yen; the bottle is five hundred milliliters for four hundred yen. Their capacities are on the price labels too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百ミリリットル当たりだと袋のほうが安いですね。でも、初めて買うなら本体が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単位量の価格差を踏まえ初回に本体が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The pouch is cheaper per hundred milliliters. But do I need the bottle for a first purchase?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consider unit prices and ask whether the first purchase needs the bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は専用のボトルに詰め替える表示です。容器をお持ちでなければ、まず本体を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The product says to refill its dedicated bottle. If you don't have the container, choose the main bottle first.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら本体から買います。香りの強い物は避けたいので、無香料の表示がある物を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体を選び無香料表示の商品を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll start with the bottle. I'd like to avoid strong fragrances, so please show me one labeled fragrance-free.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the main bottle and request a fragrance-free label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ棚の青いボトルに無香料と表示があります。こちらも五百ミリリットルで四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The blue bottle on the same shelf says fragrance-free. It is also five hundred milliliters for four hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青いボトルを一つにします。次に買う詰め替え用を間違えないよう、同じシリーズの袋も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い本体を一つ選び対応する詰め替え袋を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take one blue bottle. Please show me the refill pouch in the same series too, so I don't buy the wrong refill next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one blue bottle and ask for the matching refill pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの青いラベルの袋です。商品名を照合してください。今日はボトルだけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This pouch with the blue label. Compare the product names. Just the bottle today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ商品名の袋を覚えました。今日は本体一つだけ、四百円でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対応商品名を確認して本体だけ四百円で買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the pouch with the same product name. Today, just one main bottle for four hundred yen, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the matching name and decide to buy only the bottle for four hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本体一つ、四百円ですね。こちらをレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-NAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: One bottle for four hundred yen, then. Please take it to the register. Thank you.
